property.value: Hey there, this path leads to WCity. It's an adventure map I've been working on that will receive constant updates. property.name: Text 1
property.value: You can summon a monster in attack mode or set it in face down defense mode from your hand. You can't switch from attack to defense or defense to attack the same turn you play it on the field so be careful. First player to destroy 3 monsters, wins.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You can activate spells from the pause menu with various effects. Each spell has a cost of 1, 2, 3 or 4 spell counters. You gain spell 1 spell counter if you destroy an opponent's monster and 2 if your monster gets destroyed. Buffs to attack only last 1 turn and buffs to defense last until the monster is destroyed. You can only activate one spell per turn.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You may only attack once per turn and only monsters in attack mode can attack. In a battle with 2 ATK position monsters, the monster with highest attack wins. In a battle with a DEF position monster (either face up or face down), then attack gets halved and deducted from DEF monster. If it fails to destroy the monster this way, then the attacking monster is switched to defense mode.
